Spooky Halloween

musiclucke

Halloween is not a day away,
The creepy, freaky holiday is today!
The moon is rising, shining bright,
The spirits give us such a fright.

Ghosts are dancing through the night,
Witches flying — what a fright!
Pumpkins glow with light so green,
It’s a spooky Halloween!

Now be quiet, I feel so sleepy,
But this night is just too creepy!

Trick or treat, let’s have some fun,
Halloween has just begun!
Give me sweets, and don’t be mean,
Or things get creepy this Halloween!

And all the eerie ghosts
Will turn you into toast!
